company.name: EPIC AEROSPACE
company.shortDescription: We are building the first space-transportation network.
company.description: EPIC is building the physical layer to the internet of satellites. We are connecting every point in space with the first reusable space-tug.

productsAndServices.description: A low Earth orbit (LEO) orbit transfer vehicle designed to deploy and maneuver satellites with a 300 kg payload capacity and 900N hypergolic propulsion.
productsAndServices.name: CHIMERA LEO 1

productsAndServices.description: A LEO orbit transfer vehicle variant with 295s Isp, 300 kg max payload, and 200 m/s delta-V for apogee kick missions and simple orbital maneuvers.
productsAndServices.name: CHIMERA LEO BLOCK 0

productsAndServices.description: A LEO orbit transfer vehicle variant with 295s Isp, 300 kg max payload, and 1000 m/s delta-V for advanced orbital maneuvers including LTAN changes.
productsAndServices.name: CHIMERA LEO BLOCK 1

productsAndServices.description: A geosynchronous orbit (GEO) orbit transfer vehicle that moves payloads from GTO to GEO with 310s Isp, 300 kg max payload, and 1800 m/s delta-V.
productsAndServices.name: CHIMERA GEO BLOCK 0

productsAndServices.description: A GEO orbit transfer vehicle variant with 310s Isp, 290 kg max payload, station-keeping capabilities, and power options for hosted payloads.
productsAndServices.name: CHIMERA GEO BLOCK 0 (BUS)

productsAndServices.description: Development and manufacturing of propulsion systems using non-toxic hypergolic propellants, including main engines and reaction control thrusters.
productsAndServices.name: Propulsion Systems

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,954,578 to $9,394,062, a 3.18x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 17 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
